stem.text: A shop sign weighing $75\,\text{N}$ hangs from a frame attached to a vertical wall.

stem.alt: Frame attached to a hatched vertical wall. Horizontal rod XY is hinged at X on the wall and has a length of 0.50 m; rod YZ is drawn from Y up to Z on the wall, marked at 30° to the horizontal. A sign hangs vertically from Y and is labelled sign, weight 75 N. Labels: wall, X, Y, Z.

stem.text: The frame consists of a horizontal rod XY and a rod YZ that is at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the horizontal. Rod XY is attached to the wall by a hinge at X and has length $0.50\,\text{m}$. Assume that the weights of the rods are negligible.
What is the horizontal force exerted by the wall on rod XY?
